cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) with one prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3), no reinforcing route; E3 point Parfum (Fragrance) (10). Laureth-4/-23, Trideceth-10, PEG esters are not routes (C3). Refatting/conditioning counter-signals recorded (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate 5, Dimethicone 8); the realistic unknown is the single buffer's level -> neighbor strong.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2: early (prominent) silicone Dimethicone (8), cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (13), pearlizing Glycol Distearate (16), humectant Panthenol (7); reinforced by Amodimethicone (12), Hydrolyzed Keratin (6), PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (5), Hydrogenated Castor Oil (15), Apricot Kernel Oil (21). Multiple complementary systems; reasonable unknowns would not move it.

depositionLoad.rationale: Prominent dimethicone + amodimethicone + guar form a substantial silicone/coacervate system; keratin is prominent but a low-persistence hydrolysate; lipids are post-fragrance.

persistence.rationale: Dimethicone and amino-silicone are persistent and can accumulate; protein and post-fragrance oils add little persistence; no prominent waxy lipid.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLES with one betaine buffer and a refatter: ordinary reset.

weightPotential.counterEvidence: W1 is excluded by condition (c): a prominent protein film (Hydrolyzed Keratin 6) reinforces the silicone/guar/amodimethicone set, and a waxy lipid (15) is present. Multiple families converge, pulling toward high.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A persistent silicone/amino-silicone/guar system on an ordinary sulfate chassis gives noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the extra families beyond the silicone/guar/amodimethicone set are a low-persistence protein hydrolysate and post-fragrance lipids; there is no W-RICH (no prominent payload lipid) and reset is not limited. Not low: a prominent dimethicone with amodimethicone and guar is plainly a depositing system (W2).
weightPotential.limitingFactor: Several converging families with unknown levels; high is a realistic one-step neighbor (close to W3, but moderate judged better supported).
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate (depositionLoad moderate, persistence moderate, resetCapacity moderate); neighbor high.
weightPotential.selfCheck: Fingerprint matches; blind judgment; no count/position assigned band; three subjudgments present; whyNotNeighborBand specific; no in-lane comparison.

careDirection.limitation: Humectant side rests mainly on one prominent humectant (panthenol); repair side on keratin + amino-silicone.

'Locken/Curls' is texture, not a focus (T2).
